source: NAR official monthly race data (approximately four years, including a final one-year holdout); raw archives are not retained

frame_effect.method: Official frame number versus finish position; descriptive only. No frame effect is added to live model scores unless a separate chronological holdout proves improvement.

data_quality_audit.policy: Coverage diagnostics only; missing values are not imputed as observed facts and this report does not imply predictive value.

method.prediction_order: date-batched chronological; every race on a date is predicted before any result from that date updates history or model weights
method.production_parity: Primary chronological backtest uses the same D performance, going, pace, temperature and learned frame-context scoring blocks as live predictions; odds are overlaid only from genuine timestamped pre-off snapshots.
method.frame_feature: Prior top-three rate by venue, surface, 400m distance band, field-size band and frame number; 8% blend with D performance score, neutral prior for sparse/missing buckets; updates only after all races on a date are predicted.
method.market_value_policy: Simulate win bets only when calibrated model probability multiplied by timestamped official pre-off win odds meets a fixed threshold; thresholds are reported independently and not selected on test folds.
method.probability_calibration: temperature fitted on chronological prequential training predictions; out-of-sample calibration reported per walk-forward fold
method.ticket_policy: Research ticket portfolio is reported separately from the production shadow portfolio; each virtual ticket is 100 JPY and is not a betting recommendation.
method.shadow_ticket_policy: Exact production shadowTickets policy: model rank 1 win; ranks 1-2 place; ranks 1-2 wide; ranks 1-3 trio; 100 JPY each, evaluated separately from actual BET decisions.
method.ticket_generation: Active research portfolio only: wide all pairs among top 3 (3); exacta first-place top 2 x second-place top 3 excluding same horse (4); trio all combinations from top 5 (10); trifecta first-place top 2 x second-place top 5 excluding first x third-place remaining top 5 excluding first and second (24). Win, place and quinella are excluded from candidate selection and ticket evaluation. Each ticket costs 100 JPY.
limitations: No historical pre-race odds feature; NAR monthly odds are confirmed odds and are not used.
All payout rows for dead-heat races are retained and matched across every winning combination.
Ticket ranks use field-size-normalized historical finishes; probabilities are temperature-calibrated and evaluated in rolling holdout folds.
Missing or incomplete historical rows are excluded where necessary.

shadow_portfolio.policy: Mirrors production shadowTickets: model rank 1 win; ranks 1-2 place; ranks 1-2 wide; ranks 1-3 trio; 100 JPY each; no odds-based real-bet selection.

auto_improvement_loop.selection_method: Each candidate must clear its type-specific sample and ROI-edge hurdle in every available prior fold. Selection uses no validation-fold outcomes; baseline is the fallback. Selection hurdles are not profitability gates.
auto_improvement_loop.promotion_policy: No model is automatically promoted from a single fold. Require repeated next-fold gains, adequate samples, and independent market-odds validation before production use.

integrated_strategy_E.policy: Pre-registered integrated challenger; no parameter selection on the validation folds.

out_of_sample_validation.method: three rolling-origin folds with non-overlapping test windows; weights frozen within each test window; prior results added only after all races on a date are scored; market-value bets use timestamped official pre-off odds snapshots

trifecta_diagnostics.interpretation: hit_rate is winning tickets divided by tickets; race_hit_rate is races with at least one winning ticket divided by races. ROI confidence intervals use a race-level normal ratio approximation and are diagnostic, not a promotion guarantee. Role coverage and ticket ROI are reported separately.

formation_2_4_5.allocation_method: Exploratory rank-weighted allocation with the same total stake per race as 100-yen equal staking. Historical pre-off trio combination odds are unavailable, so these policies are not expected-value or Kelly staking.

trio_diagnostics.interpretation: Trio tickets are unordered combinations. hit_rate is winning tickets divided by tickets; race_hit_rate is races with at least one winning ticket divided by races. ROI confidence intervals use a race-level normal ratio approximation and are diagnostic, not a promotion guarantee. Top5 is the unchanged fixed baseline. formation_2_4_5 is top2 / top4 / ranks3-7 with duplicate unordered combinations removed. Allocation policies keep the same race-level stake and reweight 100-yen units by model rank; they are exploratory, not EV staking.

integrated_strategy_E.policy: Fixed 0.30 calibrated top-win probability gate; role-specific trifecta ranking blend 0.10; 2-3-4 formation. The reference uses the same qualifying races and formation with ordinary ranking, isolating the ranking change. Parameters are not selected on the holdout fold.

period_comparison.method: Previous two years are aggregated from two sequential one-year out-of-sample windows. Each year's model is trained only on dates before that year's test window. The recent year is a separate final holdout trained on the preceding three years. Hit rate is winning tickets / all tickets; ROI is official payout / stake.

recent_history_comparison._method: Same chronological holdout races and same trained weights; before excludes each horse's last-five-run form/venue/distance inputs, after includes them. Sire, jockey and age features remain identical.

out_of_sample_validation.selection_rule: Each fold uses only strictly earlier training data; test weights remain fixed and race results are added to history only after the entire date is scored.

promotion_gate.scope: Aggregated untouched walk-forward validation folds; development folds are not counted toward the validation sample.

final_odds_market_benchmark.source: NAR official monthly confirmed win odds; retrospective market benchmark only, not pre-off purchasable odds
final_odds_market_benchmark.comparison: C model top-ranked horse vs lowest final win odds (market favorite), same eligible races, one 100 JPY win ticket per race

strategy_comparison.C_performance_pace: out_of_sample_validation.models.C_performance_pace (B + prior margin/last3f/time + race pace + smoothed prior frame-context effect)
strategy_comparison.D_preoff_odds: preoff_ranking_strategy_backtest (timestamped 2-30 minute snapshots only; separately reports snapshot coverage)
strategy_comparison.comparison_design: A-C are evaluated on identical chronological holdout races with identical ticket construction and 100 JPY per ticket. B and C share the same learned base weights intentionally so their difference isolates the added feature blocks; A is the fixed baseline. D is evaluated only on races with valid genuine pre-off snapshots and is never imputed for missing snapshots.
strategy_comparison.comparison_policy: A-E are reported separately. D is marked unevaluable until enough genuine pre-off snapshots exist. No strategy is declared profitable unless sample minimums are met and the 95% race-cluster ROI lower bound exceeds 100%.

odds_snapshot_archive.note: The closest valid snapshot from 30 to 2 minutes before post time is used; snapshots inside the final 2 minutes, post-off records, and monthly confirmed odds are excluded.

preoff_value_backtest.minimum_sample_rule: At least 100 races with bets and 300 tickets per threshold; a candidate additionally needs the race-cluster bootstrap 95% lower ROI bound above 100%. Threshold selection uses the first 70% of dates only; the last 30% remains untouched holdout.
preoff_value_backtest.policy: Flat 100-yen win bets only when saved calibrated win probability multiplied by timestamped pre-off win odds meets the threshold. Returns use official settled 100-yen payouts.
preoff_value_backtest.note: Only the closest valid pre-off snapshot from 30 to 2 minutes before post time per race is evaluated. No monthly confirmed odds are substituted.

preoff_ticket_type_backtest.selection_policy: Each bet type is evaluated and selected independently. Threshold selection uses only the first 70% of dates; the final 30% is untouched holdout. Candidate pass requires at least 100 races, 300 tickets, and a race-cluster bootstrap 95% lower ROI bound above 100%.
preoff_ticket_type_backtest.probability_model: Plackett-Luce top-three finish probabilities derived from calibrated win probabilities; combination odds are taken from the same timestamped official pre-off snapshot.

risk_diagnostics.note: Drawdown is measured from the running peak of cumulative net profit, starting at zero; no assumed starting bankroll is used.

race_budget_auto_strategy_backtest.stake_rule: Up to 20 qualified tickets; target stake is 100 JPY per qualified ticket (max 2,000 JPY), allocated proportionally by max(0.0001, (EV-1) * sqrt(probability)) in 100-yen units. Unused budget is not forced into a race.
race_budget_auto_strategy_backtest.selection_rule: Use only bet-type thresholds that passed development-date validation. For each holdout race, choose the eligible bet type with the highest mean expected value using same-snapshot pre-off odds; if none qualifies, skip the race.
race_budget_auto_strategy_backtest.profitability_rule: At least 100 holdout races with bets and 300 tickets, plus a race-cluster bootstrap 95% ROI lower bound above 100%.
race_budget_auto_strategy_backtest.note: ROI is a historical simulation using official settled payouts, not proof of future profit. If current-version snapshots are too few, the workflow reports insufficient evidence rather than inventing results.

preoff_ranking_strategy_backtest.policy: For each bet type, rank the full pre-off candidate universe by expected value, model hit probability, or market odds; buy the same fixed top-N count. Select a ranking only on the first 70% of dates and evaluate it on the untouched last 30%. A strategy is not validated unless its holdout has adequate sample and race-cluster bootstrap 95% ROI lower bound above 100%.

online_learning.note: Daily batch learning: all races on a date are scored before that date's results update weights for later dates.
